adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` only pushes an `EventResult` when it successfully resolves a credential and calls `createEvent(...)`. If `destination.credentialId` is set but the credential cannot be found in `this.calendarCredentials` and the DB lookup also fails, the code does nothing (no `else`, no logging, no failed `EventResult`). This silently skips creating that calendar event, which would lead to missing created events/booking references for that destination compared to the previous single-destination behavior.
